reader.requirement: At --std 85 the compiler must refuse JUSTIFIED written on any index data item (USAGE IS INDEX, written on the item or inherited from a group USAGE INDEX, at any level including 77) and must keep admitting index data items without the clause.
reader.edition-search: Read CheckClauseSubjectsPass.Run and DataBinder.JustifiedViolation whole: JustifiedViolation is a static test of PicInfo.Category (Alphanumeric/National/Boolean) and EditMask with no edition parameter; Run consults binder.Edition only to position and report the diagnostic (Edition.At / Edition.Error), and passes DialectLevel only to the SYNCHRONIZED arm. Grep of the pass for Edition|Version|Std found nothing else.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness pb518_clause_placement_legal is a legal-placement case; the refusal on an index data item (written, 77, inherited from a group USAGE INDEX) is not exercised by it

reader.notes: The index data item carries a PicInfo whose category is index, so the category test in JustifiedViolation refuses it on the same code at every edition; the 1985 SR4 is the 2023 SR3 category test's consequence. The diagnostic cites §2023:13.18.32.3 SR3 rather than the 1985 rule, a wording point only.
